== Summary ==
Players Committee current full-face Endor image, [[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 3)]]. The exact [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/hires/endorewokvillage.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-12-12T00:40:28Z; the [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c GIF-path copy] was committed 08:04:04Z that day. Their RGB pixels and dimensions are identical; this is one published image state. Existing Wiki image bytes are unchanged. The face prints E1; its article ordinal is Errata 3 after insertion of the older published partial. Lucasfilm Ltd.; image published by the Players Committee.
